# Implementation Plan: Visual Task Event-Stream Stage Diagram

> **Mode:** Read-only `plan` (repository untouched at `HEAD 270d721`; no files edited).

## 1. Goal and Acceptance Mapping

**Assignment:** Create a visual diagram to show which stage the task is in the event stream.  
**Acceptance Criteria:** Each task has a visual diagram of its path in the event stream.

Every task opened in the Agents reader (`#agents-reader`)—across autonomous native workflows, autonomous external Muse workflows, standalone `Plan`/`Review`/`Implement` tasks, linked reviewer/repair tasks, and merged tasks with post-merge delivery—will render a **read-only visual stage-path diagram** showing:

1. **The task's ordered pipeline stages** (matching its actual workflow/execution track).
2. **Which stage the task is currently in**, with explicit visual emphasis, semantic glyph + tone, and `aria-current="step"`.
3. **The task's observed path through the event stream**: completed/witnessed stages, revision/repair loops (with re-entry counts and budget context), terminal or blocked exception branches attached to the stage where work halted, and unreached/skipped downstream stages.
4. **An accessible, keyed native disclosure (`<details>`)** listing the bounded chronological stage transitions (sequence ranges and exact UTC timestamps without requiring hover).

**Why `#agents-reader` (and not dense diagrams inside `#agents-tasks` list rows):**
- `WorkList` returns `WorkTaskSummary` without `WorkLogEvent`s, revision counts, review/publication state, or `workflow.kind` (native vs. external). Drawing an event-stream path on list rows would either fabricate unwitnessed history or require N+1 `WorkEvents` calls.
- List rows in `#agents-tasks` already show the current authoritative stage badge (`task_summary_badge`); opening any task immediately reveals its visual stage-path diagram near the top of `#agents-reader` (directly below `#agents-task-correlation`, above `#agents-workflow`, `#agents-delivery`, and `#agents-history-panel`).

---

## 2. Architecture and Ownership Boundaries

This design requires **zero backend Python, PostgreSQL schema, or HTTP protocol changes**—all required stage and event data already flow through the admitted `ide.work.get` and `ide.work.events` contracts (`protocol_version: 1`, `Forge-Delivery-Version: 1`).

| Layer | Owner | Responsibility | Must Not Do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Domain & projection** | [forge-ide-ui](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-ui/src/model/agents.rs) (Rust/WASM in worker) | Fold verified `WorkLogEvent`s into a bounded `StageTrace`, combine with authoritative `WorkTaskDetail`, format relative/UTC times, and emit `FlowDiagramBinding` in `ViewModel`. | Emit raw HTML/SVG strings, retain unbounded event logs, or trust foreign-correlation/unverified progress events. |
| **Declarative authoring** | [application.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/application.rs) & [component.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/component.rs) | Declare generic `Component::FlowDiagram` (`component!(flow_diagram ...)`), validated in `Document::validate()`. | Hide HTML/CSS/JS strings or task-specific logic in component macros. |
| **Audited emitters & styles** | [html.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/html.rs), [javascript.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/javascript.rs), [styles.yaml](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/ui/styles.yaml) | Render generic `FlowDiagramBinding` nodes, directional connectors, branch/loop callouts, and keyed trace disclosure using `.textContent` and decorative `aria-hidden` SVG arrows; clear synchronously in `clearProtected()`. | Compute stage transitions, parse raw wire timestamps, call backend endpoints, or use `innerHTML`. |
| **Native host & wiring** | [assets.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web-host/src/assets.rs) & [work.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web-host/src/work.rs) | Validate the matching atomic bundle (`abi_version: 15`) and keep existing `WorkRelayFactory` / `AssetFactory` bootstrap wiring unchanged. | Introduce global registries, new HTTP endpoints, or empty registrars for pure UI reducers. |

---

## 3. Event-Stream Stage Model (`forge-ide-ui`)

### 3.1 Bounded Monotonic `StageTrace` (New module: `src/rust/forge-ide-ui/src/model/agents/stage_diagram.rs`)

Because `Agents::history` retains only one 50-event page at a time ([history.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-ui/src/model/agents/history.rs)), navigating First/Previous/Next must **not** erase earlier observed stages. Instead, `Agents` will maintain a compact, fixed-bound `stage_trace: StageTrace`:

- **Population points:** Fold verified events monotonically (`event.sequence > self.last_sequence`) in both:
  1. `accept_history()` when `page.cursor == 0` (initial page 1–50, alongside `keep_progress`), and
  2. `complete_work(WorkResponse::WorkEvents)` in the incremental `read_events` drain path (alongside `keep_progress`).
- **Reset points:** Cleared in `clear_progress()` and `clear_history()` (on task switch, project switch, back-to-list, or `changed == true` in `WorkOpened` where `event_sequence` resets to `0`).
- **Strict provenance filtering (identical to [history.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-ui/src/model/agents/history.rs#L117-L150)):**
  - Every `WorkEvents` batch is already rejected if any `event.correlation_id != task.correlation_id`.
  - `workflow_progress` is folded only if `task.workflow.workflow_id == p.workflow_id`.
  - Native `progress` (`WorkProgressStage::Plan` / `Progress`) is folded only if `event.progress_verified || task.attempt.attempt_id == p.attempt_id`.
  - `external_progress` is folded only if `task.external_result` is absent or matches `p.assignment_id`.
- **Hard memory & ABI bounds:**
  - Per-stage stats map bounded to the closed set of stages (`<= 16` slots): `{ visits: u32, checkpoint_count: u32, first_sequence: u64, last_sequence: u64, first_at: String, last_at: String }`.
  - Ordered transition hop list bounded to `MAX_STAGE_HOPS = 32` entries, collapsing consecutive checkpoints in the same stage (e.g., 40 consecutive `Checkpoint` events increment the active hop's `event_count` and update `last_sequence` / `last_at`). If more than 32 distinct stage transitions occur, retain the first hop plus the latest 31 hops and record an explicit `omitted_hops: u32` count.

### 3.2 Canonical Task Tracks & Exact Stage Mapping

The diagram adapts truthfully to the opened task's actual track derived from `WorkTaskDetail`:

1. **Native Autonomous Workflow (`task.workflow` with `WorkWorkflowKind::Native`):**
   - Primary track: `Plan` → `Plan review` → `Implement` → `Checks` → `Code review` → `Publish` → `Hosted` → `Merge` → `Merged`.
   - Loop callouts (attached when `plan_revisions > 0`, `code_revisions > 0`, or `PlanRevision`/`Repair` observed in `StageTrace` or active):
     - `Plan revision` (`plan_revisions / max_plan_revisions`) looped back from `Plan review` → `Plan`.
     - `Repair` (`code_revisions / max_code_revisions`) looped back from `Checks` / `Code review` → `Implement`.
2. **External Database / Muse Autonomous Workflow (`task.workflow` with `WorkWorkflowKind::ExternalDatabase`):**
   - Primary track matches [external-agent-workflow.md](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/docs/architecture/external-agent-workflow.md) and [work_external_workflow.py](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/deploy/mission-control/agent-runner/work_external_workflow.py):
     `Plan` → `Plan review` → `Implement` → `Code review` → `Checks` → `Merge` → `Merged`.
   - Same `Plan revision` and `Repair` loop callouts when observed or active.
   - If historical/unexpected `Publishing` or `Hosted` checkpoints were witnessed in `StageTrace`, include them rather than dropping observed events.
3. **Standalone Implement Task (non-workflow `WorkMode::Implement`, or any task with `task.review` / `task.publication`):**
   - Primary track: `Queued` → `Running` → `Review & checks` → *(optional `Publish` when `task.publication.is_some()` or `hosted`/`approved` review stage)* → `Accepted`.
   - Reflects `task.review.stage` (e.g. `checking`, `awaiting_decision`, `repair`, `hosted_pending`, `handoff`) and `task.publication.status` (`pending`, `checking`, `publishing`, `published`, `failed`).
4. **Standalone Plan / Review / Non-Workflow External Muse / Linked Reviewer Task:**
   - Primary track: `Queued` → `Running` *(or `External runner` when `task.external_result.is_some()` with `task.attempt.is_none()`, never fabricating a native attempt)* → `Ready for review` → `Accepted`.
   - If a Plan task was revised/resumed (`WorkEventKind::Resumed` witnessed), show a `Resumed / Revised` loop indicator with visit count.
5. **Post-Merge Delivery Continuation (appended whenever `task.delivery.is_some()` on a completed/merged task):**
   - Appends delivery stages from [delivery.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-ui/src/protocol/work/delivery.rs):
     - `Verify main` (`Queued | Running | Passed | Failed | Superseded`, showing `Build N` when supplied).
     - `Main repair` (shown as a branch/loop stage when `repair.status != None` or `repair.round > 0`, showing `Round R/max_rounds`).
     - `Deploy` (`Queued | Building | Deploying | Deployed | Failed | Superseded`; displays `Deployed` with success tone **only** when `release.receipt_sha256.is_some()`, otherwise `Unverified` warning tone, matching [model/agents/delivery.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-ui/src/model/agents/delivery.rs#L13-L24)).
6. **Exception, Halt, and Degraded States (all tracks):**
   - `CancelRequested` (`Stopping`), `Cancelled`, `Failed`, `QuotaBlocked`, `BlockedAuth`, `BlockedPermission`, `NeedsReconcile`, and workflow `Escalated` (`Needs attention`): rendered as an explicit **branch node** attached to the last active stage, marking unreached downstream stages `Skipped` (never `Completed`).
   - If `NeedsReconcile` was observed earlier in the stream and later followed by `Resumed`, show it as a resolved recovery branch rather than an active block.
   - If `task.workflow_required && task.workflow.is_none()`: render an honest degraded diagram (`Workflow state unavailable` warning badge + observed raw lifecycle events).

### 3.3 Truthful Node State & Completeness Rules

- **Authoritative current stage** always comes from `WorkTaskDetail` (`workflow.phase`, `delivery`, `review`, `publication`, `status`).
- **Node states (`FlowStageState`):** `Completed`, `Current`, `Upcoming`, `Skipped`, `Warning`, `Error`, `Cancelled`.
- **Event-stream honesty:**
  - A prior stage witnessed in `StageTrace` shows its real sequence/time/visit metadata (`#1`, `2×`, `3m ago`).
  - A prior stage *not* witnessed in `StageTrace` while `!events_loaded || events_more` shows `Stream loading…` rather than fabricated sequence numbers.
  - A prior stage never witnessed after the stream finishes (`events_loaded && !events_more`) is marked `Skipped` / `Not recorded` rather than claiming an event occurred.
  - The diagram header displays stream completeness (e.g., `Events 1–41` vs. `Loading event stream…` vs. `Partial stream · events 1–50 loaded`).

### 3.4 Typed `ViewModel` Contract ([view.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-ui/src/view.rs))

Add a reusable, domain-agnostic presentation binding to `ViewModel`:

```rust
pub struct ViewModel {
    // ... existing fields ...
    pub flow_diagrams: Vec<FlowDiagramBinding>,
}

pub struct FlowDiagramBinding {
    pub id: &'static str,
    pub track_label: String,          // e.g. "Autonomous workflow · Native"
    pub current_badge: BadgeView,     // semantic pill matching current stage
    pub summary: String,              // e.g. "Stage 5 of 9 · Reviewing code · Events 1–18"
    pub nodes: Vec<FlowStageNode>,    // ordered main-path stages (<= 16)
    pub branches: Vec<FlowBranch>,    // active/observed loops or exception branches (<= 6)
    pub trace_label: String,          // disclosure summary, e.g. "Observed event path (7 transitions)"
    pub trace_hops: Vec<FlowTraceHop>,// bounded chronological hops (<= 32)
    pub empty_message: String,
}

pub enum FlowStageState {
    Completed,
    Current,
    Upcoming,
    Skipped,
    Warning,
    Error,
    Cancelled,
}

pub struct FlowStageNode {
    pub id: String,
    pub label: String,
    pub state: FlowStageState,
    pub current: bool,
    pub count_label: Option<String>,  // e.g. "2×", "Rev 1/3", "3 checkpoints"
    pub detail: String,               // concise status/sequence caption, e.g. "#4–#9"
    pub time: Option<TimeView>,       // relative label + exact ISO-8601 tooltip
}

pub enum FlowBranchKind {
    Loop,       // Plan revision, Code repair, Main repair, Resumed after reconcile
    Exception,  // Escalated, Failed, Quota/Auth/Permission blocked, Stopping, Cancelled
}

pub struct FlowBranch {
    pub id: String,
    pub kind: FlowBranchKind,
    pub from_stage_label: String,
    pub label: String,
    pub state: FlowStageState,
    pub detail: String,
    pub time: Option<TimeView>,
}

pub struct FlowTraceHop {
    pub id: String,
    pub sequence_label: String,       // e.g. "#1" or "#3–#8"
    pub badge: BadgeView,
    pub time: TimeView,
    pub detail: String,               // e.g. "6 checkpoints" or concise stage note
}
```

Also clear `view.flow_diagrams.clear()` in `Agents::project()` (mirroring `view.timelines.clear()` at [agents.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-ui/src/model/agents.rs#L1774)) and initialize `flow_diagrams: vec![]` in [projection.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-ui/src/model/projection.rs#L1112).

---

## 4. Declarative UI, Emitters, and Responsive Visual Design (`forge-ide-web`)

### 4.1 Component & Application Declarations
- **[component.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/component.rs):**
  - Add `Component::FlowDiagram { id: String, label: String }` and macro arm `(flow_diagram $id:expr, $label:expr)`.
  - Validate `id` and `label` inside `Document::validate()` (same pattern as `Component::Timeline`; verify total component count remains well under the `384` limit).
- **[application.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/application.rs#L94-L115):**
  - Insert `#agents-stage-panel` inside `#agents-reader` directly after `#agents-task-correlation` and before `#agents-workflow`:
    ```rust
    component!(region "agents-stage-panel"; [
        component!(heading "agents-stage-heading", "Event stream path"),
        component!(flow_diagram "agents-stage-diagram", "Task event-stream stage diagram"),
    ]),
    ```
  - Toggle `agents-stage-panel` visibility in `Agents::project()` whenever `active && work && reader && self.task.is_some()`.

### 4.2 Audited HTML & JavaScript Emitters
- **[html.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/html.rs):**
  - Emit a semantic region container for `Component::FlowDiagram`:
    `<section id="{id}" class="fg-flow-diagram" aria-label="{label}"></section>`
- **[javascript.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/javascript.rs):**
  - Add `let flowDiagramViews = new WeakMap();` and `renderFlowDiagram(binding)` invoked from `apply()` (`for (const b of view.flow_diagrams || []) renderFlowDiagram(b);`).
  - **Keyed DOM preservation:** Keep the outer header, `.fg-flow-track` `<ol>`, `.fg-flow-branches` `<div>`, and `<details class="fg-flow-trace">` node persistent across 2.5s background polls (comparing JSON signatures before replacing inner list items), so an open "Observed event path" disclosure and keyboard focus are **never** collapsed or lost during refresh!
  - **Visual diagram structure:**
    - Header row: track label + current stage badge (`paintBadge`) + concise progress/completeness summary.
    - Stage track (`<ol class="fg-flow-track">`): ordered `<li class="fg-flow-step" data-state="...">` nodes, each containing:
      - Stage card (`.fg-flow-node`) with `aria-current="step"` when `node.current === true`, a decorative status marker glyph (`✓`, `●`, `○`, `◌`, `!`, `×`), stage label, optional count/loop pill, sequence/detail caption, and `<time>` via `paintTime`.
      - Between consecutive nodes, a visual directional connector (`.fg-flow-connector` with `data-state` matching edge traversal and a small `aria-hidden="true"` inline SVG arrow created via `document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg')`—solid arrow for traversed edges, highlighted arrow into current stage, dashed muted connector for upcoming/skipped edges).
    - Branch/loop strip (`.fg-flow-branches`, hidden when empty): renders each `FlowBranch` card with `data-kind="loop|exception"`, `data-state`, decorative curved loop (`↺`) or fork (`↳`) SVG glyph, origin stage label (`From Plan review`), branch label, detail, and `<time>`.
    - Native disclosure (`<details class="fg-flow-trace">`): `<summary>` with `trace_label` and an `<ol class="fg-flow-hops">` of chronological hops (sequence badge, semantic pill, relative/exact `<time>`, and detail).
  - **Security & teardown:**
    - Every dynamic string uses `.textContent` (zero `innerHTML`).
    - Update `clearProtected()` to include `.fg-flow-diagram` in the synchronous `.replaceChildren()` sweep and reset `flowDiagramViews = new WeakMap()` so no task stage pixels survive `pagehide`, bfcache, or fatal recovery.

### 4.3 Responsive Dark-Surface Styling ([styles.yaml](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/ui/styles.yaml))
- Reuse existing theme tokens (`--surface`, `--raised`, `--border`, `--text`, `--muted`, `--accent`, `--warning`, `--error`, `--radius`, `--gap`, `--touch`).
- **Desktop (`>= 640px` / `1440px`):** `.fg-flow-track` renders as a clean horizontal wrapping node-and-arrow flowchart (`display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: stretch; gap: 8px 0;`) with horizontal arrow connectors between nodes.
- **Phone (`320px` & `390px`, `@media (max-width: 639px)`):** `.fg-flow-track` switches cleanly to a vertical top-to-bottom flowchart spine (`flex-direction: column`) with downward connectors rotated cleanly and full-width wrapping stage labels (`min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere;`), guaranteeing `documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth + 1`.
- **Distinct accessible state visuals:**
  - `completed`: subtle green-tinted border/marker matching `BadgeTone::Success` + `✓`.
  - `current`: high-contrast `2px solid var(--accent)` border, elevated surface `--raised`, active indicator dot `●`.
  - `upcoming`: muted translucent border (`rgba(255,255,255,.12)`), `○`.
  - `skipped`: dashed muted border (`1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.16)`), muted text, `◌`.
  - `warning`: `var(--warning)` border/marker + `!`.
  - `error`: `var(--error)` border/marker + `×`.
  - `cancelled`: neutral muted border + `×`.
- **Accessibility & reduced motion:**
  - `<details class="fg-flow-trace"> > summary` gets `min-height: 44px` touch target and crisp `:focus-visible` `2px solid var(--accent)` outline.
  - Add `.fg-flow-node,.fg-flow-trace>summary` to the `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` rule so transitions/animations disable cleanly.

---

## 5. Atomic Bundle ABI 14 → ABI 15 Coordination

Adding `flow_diagrams` to `ViewModel` and `renderFlowDiagram` to `main.js` changes the local browser bundle contract while keeping the native HTTP protocol at version 1. Following the exact convention from ABI 12 (`50183d0`) and ABI 14 (`86057ca`), update ABI `14` → `15` atomically across:

1. [src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/wasm.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/wasm.rs) (`abi_version() -> 15` + doc comment)
2. [src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/mod.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/mod.rs) (`abi_version: 15`)
3. [src/rust/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/javascript.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web/src/generate/javascript.rs) (`wasm.abi_version()!==15`)
4. [src/rust/forge-ide-web-host/src/assets.rs](file:///run/forge-coding-workspace/src/rust/forge-ide-web-host/src/assets.rs) (manifest validation `m.abi_version != 15` and unit test fixture)

## 8. Key Decisions Confirmed by This Plan

- **Placement:** Top of `#agents-reader` (`#agents-stage-panel`) so every opened task shows its visual stage-path diagram immediately while keeping `#agents-tasks` list rows compact and free of fabricated event paths.
- **No backend/schema changes:** Reuses existing admitted `ide.work.get` and `ide.work.events` contracts; only the local browser bundle ABI bumps atomically (`14 → 15`).
- **Truthfulness over guesswork:** Authoritative current stage comes from `WorkTaskDetail`; visited/loop/timestamp evidence comes strictly from correlation- and provenance-verified `WorkLogEvent`s folded monotonically into a bounded `StageTrace`.
